steps.what: Select the current scripts, program notes and production material
Compile scripts, program notes and other selected material into the production pack
Check that the compiled scripts and program notes cover the production brief and correct revisions
Save the compiled scripts and program notes in the production folder

tasks.design: Configure a manifest-driven pack template in {DOCS} that includes the producer's chosen source files and revision references. The producer retains selection and completeness checks; the ordinary folder save has no gate and earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual copying, ordering and reformatting of already selected files.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates and linked file collections can reuse approved source material.
tasks.still_hard: Decide which revision and contextual notes the production really needs.
tasks.human_edge: Understand how the pack will be used in rehearsal or filming.

ambition.what: Provide a revision-labelled production pack for each rehearsal handoff.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates and linked source collections can reduce repeated assembly while retaining editorial selection and verification.

assumptions: Boundary covers selecting, compiling, checking and storing the actual production pack. Distribution is a separate workflow and is not claimed here.

Writers and production staff supply the existing source files with title, revision and production id. The producer selects and identifies them in s1; missing revision labels and incompatible layouts are handled within retained s2 time.
Test native DOCS templates first. S2 removes copying, ordering and common formatting, not reading, revision decisions or semantic checks.

All shares are focal labour estimates, not measured baselines. Source authoring is unchanged outside labour. Ordinary same-system save s4 is one fully retained share. Upkeep is additional template repair.
unknowns: How many source files have reusable layouts and revision labels.
research_questions: Does a native linked pack preserve page order and revision references across actual source types?

already_counted.description: Selection, assembly exceptions, content checking and save remain.

incremental.description: Repair the pack template when production formats change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central assembly saving is 28 points, net 27 after upkeep. Cautious case: legacy image pages require manual layout so s2 retains 75%, saving 10 gross and 9 net; low 8 leaves further room for awkward revision references. Selection and checking retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read relevant production agreements and prior personnel commitments before mediation
Resolve personnel problems by hearing dissenting parties and mediating the production dispute
Write the necessary personnel resolution actions and owners in the restricted case note
Save the necessary personnel resolution note in the restricted case folder

tasks.design: Use an access-controlled agreement index in {DOCS} to find the production commitments relevant to the dispute. Keep the mediation and sensitive case-note authorship with the producer; no conversation recording or automated personnel judgement is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant agreements can be scattered across the production folder.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and restricted search views can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, unequal power and sensitive interpersonal issues.
tasks.human_edge: Establish trust and recognise when specialist intervention is needed.

ambition.what: No additional personnel decision authority is proposed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: restricted document views can help locate existing agreements, while mediation and sensitive resolution notes require human judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual dispute preparation, mediation and the minimal case note used to follow up commitments; no invented additional resolution report is added.
Existing agreement owners provide production id, parties, date and document type. The producer selects relevance in s1; absent metadata leads to manual reading within the retained time.

Test native restricted search first. S1 removes navigation between agreements, retaining interpretation. The sensitive note has no safe clerical extraction source, so its writing and ordinary save remain fully retained and ungated.

All baseline shares are focal producer labour estimates. Parties' participation and specialist escalation are unchanged outside labour. Incremental upkeep is for this producer's restricted view, without broadening access.
unknowns: Whether follow-up case notes are kept and what access restrictions apply.
research_questions: Can existing metadata locate relevant agreements without exposing unrelated personnel files?

already_counted.description: Agreement interpretation, mediation and necessary case-note work remain.

incremental.description: Check restricted agreement-view metadata and access after production changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central lookup saving 4.5 less 0.5 upkeep gives 4. Cautious case: agreements lack party metadata, leaving s1 at 85% retained and net 1; low 0.5 also allows extra access corrections. Mediation and note writing stay intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate production work and release checked call sheets

steps.what: Check personnel availability and activities against the production schedule
Coordinate the activities of writers, directors, managers and other personnel in production discussions
Enter agreed production activities and assemble the revised call sheet for personnel
Validate the final production call sheet and its personnel recipients for release
Send the released production call sheet to its personnel recipients

tasks.design: Configure a conflict view and call-sheet template in {PROJECT}, using {DOCS} for the finished sheet. The producer captures agreed changes, validates the final times, responsibilities and recipient list, then sends that exact snapshot through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability comparison and repeating schedule data in call sheets consume coordination time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native production schedules can drive conflict views and call-sheet templates.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve competing creative and logistical priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Know which changes the crew can realistically absorb.

ambition.what: Assess crew availability conflicts before confirming each revised shooting day.

reach.task: Prepare a call sheet from agreed schedule changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: production scheduling tools can expose availability conflicts and populate call sheets; the producer must validate operational meaning and recipient access.

assumptions: Boundary covers routine coordination and its existing call-sheet update and release. Crew work and discussion time for other roles are unchanged outside the focal denominator.

Crew or coordinators already provide person id, role, availability, scene, location and planned time in the schedule. The producer captures new agreed changes in s3; unstructured updates and conflicts need manual clarification in retained s1/s3 time.
Native scheduling configuration is tried first. S1 removes repeated cross-view comparisons; s3 removes repeated schedule/address copying and formatting, while decision capture remains.

The final sheet and recipient list exist before s4. Its release binds the exact snapshot sent in s5; any edit voids release. This boundary includes freelance crew outside the organisation. The one-share manual send is fully retained, as are ordinary author saves inside s3.
All shares are illustrative focal labour, unmeasured. Incremental upkeep covers template and directory corrections beyond the retained per-sheet checks.
unknowns: Current schedule field completeness and proportion of external crew.
research_questions: Does the template preserve day changes and location instructions on real revised schedules?

already_counted.description: Availability exceptions, discussions, change capture, final validation and sending remain.

incremental.description: Maintain the call-sheet template and crew-directory links.

approvals.approved_version: released call sheet and recipient snapshot from s4; any edit voids release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saving 5.5 from comparisons plus 16.25 from assembly, less 1.25 upkeep, is 20.5. Cautious case: availability is mostly verbal, leaving s1 at 90% and s3 at 72%; 8 gross less 1.25 gives 6.75, above the low. Discussion and release retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Secure and record script or footage rights

steps.what: Identify existing scripts or video footage rights and locate the relevant owner records
Negotiate rights to the scripts or existing video footage with the rights owner
Prepare the rights acceptance instrument for the selected scripts or footage
Check the final scripts or footage rights acceptance against the negotiated scope and buying authority
Send the authorised rights acceptance for the scripts or footage to the rights owner
Enter the executed scripts or footage rights scope and expiry in the rights register
Save the completed scripts or footage rights record in the register

tasks.design: Configure rights lookup, licence-form fields and register reuse in {CLM}, linked to asset references in {DOCS}. The producer negotiates and checks the finished acceptance before sending; only after receiving the executed licence does the producer complete the rights record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rights searches and repeated asset and licence-field entry are fragmented.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contract metadata and approved forms can reuse existing fields without interpreting novel rights clauses.
tasks.still_hard: Verify ownership and interpret permitted territory, media, term and derivative use.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a usable scope and recognise ambiguous chains of title.

ambition.what: Check reusable footage rights before commissioning replacement material.

reach.learn: Scope, territory, term and licence-chain evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: contract metadata and approved licence forms can reuse identifiers and standard fields; determining ownership and permitted use remains human work.

assumptions: Boundary covers a routine rights acquisition within the producer's existing authority through the executed-licence record. Legal specialists and rights-owner execution are unchanged outside focal labour; novel terms follow existing escalation without assumed free help.

Existing asset owners provide asset id and title; rights records provide owner, territory, media, term and licence evidence. The producer confirms identity in s1 and captures negotiated fields in s3. Missing metadata and novel clauses remain manual in retained s1/s3 time.

S6 begins only after the rights owner returns an executed licence. Producer checks the returned document and captures differences in s6; unchanged fields may prefill from s3, but the licence is the source of truth.

Test native CLM metadata and forms first. Lookup removes navigation, form reuse removes standard-field copying, and register reuse removes duplicate entry only. Interpretation and semantic checks remain. The ordinary s7 save is tiny, ungated and fully retained.

Final acceptance exists before s4. Approval binds the exact acceptance instrument and owner in s5; changed terms invalidate it. All shares are unmeasured focal labour; incremental form maintenance is deducted once.
unknowns: Proportion of acquisitions using an approved licence form and existing asset metadata.
research_questions: Can permitted-use fields represent actual licences without losing exclusions?

already_counted.description: Rights interpretation, negotiation, source capture, semantic checks, submission and record exceptions remain.

incremental.description: Maintain approved-form and rights-register field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: authorised rights acceptance instrument and rights-owner snapshot from s4; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central cuts 7.5 in lookup, 8 in form assembly and 3.6 in register entry give 19.1 gross and 18.1 net. Cautious case: uncatalogued ownership leaves lookup unchanged, novel clauses leave s3 at 85% and returned licence corrections leave s6 at 75%; gross 5 less upkeep 1 gives 4. Negotiation and release remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The producer spends less time assembling production and rights paperwork while retaining creative, personnel and contractual judgement.
reach: Production coordinator: prepare revision-controlled call sheets.
Rights coordinator: maintain asset-level licence records.
role.ambitious_version: Evaluate production changes with current schedules and rights evidence, then release specific checked artefacts.
